format: C++ (with C linkage and GLib/Soup libraries)
description: This file implements an HTTP server for a TR-069 host interface, handling incoming JSON-based requests via the Soup library, and processing GET and POST requests with detailed request parsing and response formulation.

methods.name: void HTTPRequestHandler(SoupServer * server,SoupServerMessage * msg,const char * path,GHashTable * query,void * user_data)
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, parses JSON payloads, distinguishes GET and POST methods, invokes request handling functions, and sends back JSON responses with appropriate HTTP status codes.

methods.name: void * HTTPServerStartThread(void * msg)
methods.description: Initializes and starts the HTTP server in a new thread, setting up the Soup server, adding request handler, and signaling readiness via condition variable.

methods.name: void HttpServerStop()
methods.description: Stops the running HTTP server by disconnecting Soup server and logging shutdown.
